scope: Phase 3 isolated reminder turn and deterministic WhatsApp presenter

journey.persistence: Stateful simulated database functions and queries
journey.transport: Rendered reply returned to host; no real WhatsApp send

productionRouting: V2 remains disconnected; background worker unchanged
limitations: Phase 3 is not rollout-ready: durable effect identity, uncertain-write reconciliation, state serialization and outbound idempotency remain.
Checkpoint replay guard is sequential only and depends on host-supplied saved state.
Single provider decision per turn; multi-hop reasoning, token/spend budgets and compaction remain Phase 4.
Open-ended chat, voice transcription and real provider/persistence/transport parity are not certified by this unit.
